meaning: Proposed required behavior: NFT-ready media and metadata generation completes before any mint request minting is optional and requires a separate confirmation showing wallet, network, and estimated fee the sharing user receives the NFT and pays the minting fee only when minting is confirmed declining or not confirming minting creates no mint fee and no blockchain effect the first network is Solana devnet; mainnet is out of scope the NFT is bound to one exact Knowledge Artifact Version NFT possession or transfer grants no definition ownership, KEP co-ownership, copyright, license, publication right, or protocol authority Definition NFT represents an exact shared definition as collectible visual card editions. Different visual variants share the same base image and exact definition version. Card transfer does not change KEP ownership, access or definition rights. Configure named visual variants and a positive edition size for each. A card copy is identified by collection, variant and serial number within that edition. At most one successful finalized mint may occupy each copy identity; other configured copies are intentional editions, not duplicates. Proposed v1 rule: freeze the collection manifest before its first mint; changed artwork or edition sizes require a new explicitly identified collection. A retry keeps the same card-copy identity and cannot consume another edition slot. An uncertain outcome blocks a replacement attempt for that copy until reconciliation establishes its outcome. A proven failure requires fresh confirmation. No automatic replacement transaction or remint of a successfully minted copy. Use one explicitly approved base image and named visual treatments to create related card variants. Bind the base-image digest, variant image digest, collection manifest, serial number and exact definition version in each copy metadata. Preview every variant before freezing the collection. Private definition content is never included automatically. Artwork and renderer selection remain separate choices. Keep a content-addressed local review/export copy. Before minting, require an explicitly configured content-addressed retrieval location and a successful exact-byte readback of media and metadata. Promise verifiable bytes at confirmation, not permanent availability; show that limit to the user. Provider choice and deployment remain separate implementation work. For initial minting, authenticate the sharing Knowledge Identity and verify its receiving/paying wallet with a one-use challenge bound to the exact collection, variant, copy, representation, devnet and expiry. Later card transfers are authorized by the current NFT holder; receiving a card does not grant KEP access or require pretending that the recipient is the original sharer. Show collection, visual variant, copy number, edition size, exact preview, receiving/paying wallet, devnet, fee estimate/ceiling and storage availability limit before separate mint confirmation. Changed commitments or exceeded fee ceiling require fresh confirmation. Declining causes no submission or mint fee.
source_or_proposal: Revised local proposal with user-directed collectible variants; exact edition and transfer rules remain proposed.
